The government had also reported that more than 10,000 households were affected by flooding. Earlier figures also recorded that about 4,845 people were displaced, forcing them to shelter in safe areas temporarily. Several regions suffered extensive structural damage, complicating rescue and relief operations as local authorities coordinated efforts to reach affected families. In Nairobi, heavy rainfall overwhelmed drainage systems, submerging streets and destroying property, leaving residents stranded in some parts of the city.
